factions.name: Affected community
factions.summary: Wants accessible exceptions and timely resolution. Value profile used for this panel: access=0.9, adaptability=0.6, continuity=0.7, oversight=-0.1, safety=0.2. Favors practical flexibility when circumstances differ. Prioritizes broad access when procedures exclude affected people. Balances precaution against the costs of unnecessary restriction. Values keeping essential operations moving through disruption. Balances formal oversight with direct operating authority.

factions.name: Implementation council
factions.summary: Balances operational continuity with reviewable safeguards. Value profile used for this panel: access=0.2, adaptability=0.4, continuity=0.8, oversight=0.6, safety=0.5. Values discretion to adapt a rule to the facts of a case. Balances broader access against the limits of the stated process. Values reducing safety exposure even when action becomes slower. Values controls that make exceptions auditable. Values keeping essential operations moving through disruption.

factions.name: Front-line operators
factions.summary: Want practical discretion and continuity of service. Value profile used for this panel: access=0.5, adaptability=0.6, continuity=0.9, oversight=-0.3, safety=0.7. Accepts lighter approval controls when they obstruct timely action. Values reducing safety exposure even when action becomes slower. Values making services reachable through more than one channel. Values discretion to adapt a rule to the facts of a case. Prioritizes continuity when the normal workflow is interrupted.

factions.name: Access delegates
factions.summary: Prioritizes workable exceptions for people facing access barriers. Value profile used for this panel: access=0.9, adaptability=0.6, continuity=0.5, oversight=-0.1, safety=0.2. Balances precaution against the costs of unnecessary restriction. Values keeping essential operations moving through disruption. Balances formal oversight with direct operating authority. Values discretion to adapt a rule to the facts of a case. Values making services reachable through more than one channel.

factions.name: Assurance reviewers
factions.summary: Want conservative thresholds and explicit authority. Value profile used for this panel: access=-0.1, adaptability=-0.9, continuity=0.6, oversight=0.7, safety=0.9. Prioritizes conservative safeguards when consequences are uncertain. Balances broader access against the limits of the stated process. Values keeping essential operations moving through disruption. Resists discretionary departures from a common process. Prioritizes explicit approval and reviewable decision authority.

factions.summary: Want practical discretion and continuity of service. Value profile used for this panel: access=0.0, adaptability=0.7, continuity=0.6, oversight=-0.3, safety=0.8. Has no fixed preference for expanding or narrowing access. Values reducing safety exposure even when action becomes slower. Treats formal oversight as secondary to direct resolution. Values keeping essential operations moving through disruption. Favors practical flexibility when circumstances differ.

factions.name: Assurance reviewers
factions.summary: Want conservative thresholds and explicit authority. Value profile used for this panel: access=-0.3, adaptability=-0.7, continuity=0.1, oversight=0.9, safety=0.8. Resists discretionary departures from a common process. Balances operational continuity against reasons to pause. Values reducing safety exposure even when action becomes slower. Prioritizes explicit approval and reviewable decision authority. Accepts narrower access when expansion would weaken the stated process.

factions.name: Affected community
factions.summary: Wants accessible exceptions and timely resolution. Value profile used for this panel: access=0.8, adaptability=-0.2, continuity=0.3, oversight=0.5, safety=0.8. Prioritizes broad access when procedures exclude affected people. Prioritizes conservative safeguards when consequences are uncertain. Has no fixed preference between discretion and uniform treatment. Prioritizes explicit approval and reviewable decision authority. Prioritizes continuity when the normal workflow is interrupted.
